test_union_timedeltaindex: test the union operation on two TimedeltaIndex objects with overlapping ranges
test_union_sort_false: test the union operation on TimedeltaIndex with sort=False preserving original order
test_union_coverage: test union edge cases including deprecated 'd' unit and empty index unions
test_union_freq_infer: test that union infers frequency on TimedeltaIndex even when inputs have no freq
test_intersection_timedeltaindex: test the intersection operation on two TimedeltaIndex objects with overlapping and non-overlapping ranges
test_intersection_sort: test intersection outcome given the sort keyword on TimedeltaIndex
test_intersection_zero_length: test intersection with zero-length TimedeltaIndex inputs
test_difference_freq: test that difference of TimedeltaIndex does not preserve frequency for non-contiguous results
test_difference_sort: test difference operation on unsorted TimedeltaIndex with sort parameter
